    void
    SimulationHistoryCoordinator.captureSnapshot(H3SimulationEngine engine)
    Capture a scalar telemetry snapshot of the current engine state.
    void
    SimulationHistoryCoordinator.captureSnapshot(H3SimulationEngine engine, TelemetryEvaluationResult result)
    Records a time-series snapshot directly from an already-evaluated TelemetryEvaluationResult, strictly evaluating zero additional engine getters for unsubscribed indicators.
    void
    SimulationHistoryCoordinator.captureWorldSnapshot(H3SimulationEngine engine)
    Captures a world state snapshot: - Immediate non-blocking RAM clone into bounded LRU rolling buffer. - In planned batch runs or on disk intervals: offloads compression to background worker. - In unbounded interactive mode: holds rolling buffer in memory and only persists to disk periodically or upon flush/shutdown, preventing unnecessary synchronous I/O churn.
